verdict.rationale: Typesense documents an official MCP server for Typesense Cloud. Through it, agents can create and configure clusters, build collections, index data, tune search and read metrics from the conversation, which covers the index-operations and analytics parts of the story. The docs also have a 'Typesense for AI Agents' guide, and llms.txt positions the product as a search engine for AI agents. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that the MCP server exposes direct search/query tool calls, any self-hosted (non-Cloud) MCP or tool-calling surface, in-depth tool documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
